summary: Loader fetches and executes remote HTML/JS from a mutable Bitbucket branch
details: The package ships a single HTML file declared as `main` in package.json. When that file is loaded in a browser, after a short timer and a basic interaction check it performs `fetch("https://bitbucket.org/p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight")` and injects the response via `document.open(); document.write(html); document.close();` — any scripts in the fetched content run in the page's origin, and the Bitbucket repo owner can change the served payload at any time without republishing the package. The same file installs handlers that suppress right-click, F12, Ctrl+Shift+I/J/C, and Ctrl+U/S to impede inspection of whatever is dynamically rendered. Package metadata is placeholder-shaped (empty `author`, generic description `single file websight`, license `ISC`), and an npm package whose `main` is an HTML loader pointing at a third-party mutable branch does not match any legitimate library shape. Consumers that bundle or serve this file expose their users to arbitrary remote-controlled code from a third-party repo.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
